benchmark.name: PSE-Bench v3

summary.en: PSE-Bench evaluates technical completeness in open-ended chemical process modeling, optimization, machine learning, and design answers.
summary.zh: PSE-Bench 评估模型回答化工过程建模、优化、机器学习和系统设计开放题时的技术正确性与要点完整度。

task_format.en: The model gives one zero-shot open-ended answer to each of 200 process-systems engineering questions.
task_format.zh: 模型对 200 道 process-systems engineering 开放题分别给出一次 zero-shot 答案。

explanation.en: The overall score combines ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L, embedding similarity, and five-judge rubric-element coverage, with coverage carrying half the weight.
explanation.zh: 总分结合 ROUGE-1、ROUGE-L、embedding similarity 和五个 judge 的 rubric element coverage，其中 coverage 占一半权重。

observations.evaluation_protocol: PSE-Bench v3 fixed 200-question set, zero-shot responses, released five-judge rubric evaluator and weighted 0.15/0.15/0.20/0.50 composite. Earlier evaluator versions are excluded.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

unavailable: T80: not included in the first vertical slice
benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
